title: Ouagadougou municipal workers indefinite strike
notes: Opened January7 retrospective dates indefinite strike to November5,2020. January public assembly and attendance not established. Unread April Le Pays excerpt claims February resumption, without reliable physical ending date; blocked403 retained. No January duplication.

title: Souri farmers Cité-Relais land compensation protest
notes: January12 publication of January3 MBDHP statement reports farmers demonstrating December2 over unmet land compensation promises. December3 alleged torture is separate chronology, not January event response. No January gathering or attendance documented.

title: Health-sciences students repeated strike campaign since November2020
notes: AIB identifies repeated strikes since November, not a precisely dated continuous public protest episode. July2020 boycott history also appears in Studio Yafa. Campaign lead only; relation to January actions requires review, not automatic ownership reassignment or merger.
